description.zh:
加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

默认查询所有加速域名。
description.en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, all accelerated domain names are queried.

description.zh: 查询类型。传dynamic时，查询全站加速动态资源的平均响应时间和静态资源的平均响应时间；默认不传，查询静态资源的平均响应时间。
description.en: The type of the query. If you set this parameter to dynamic, the average response time of dynamic resources and the average response time of static resources for Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) are queried. By default, this parameter is left empty, and the average response time of static resources is queried.

description.zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。获取日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。根据您指定**StartTime**和**EndTime**两者的时间跨度，该参数取值如下：

- 3天以内（不包含3天整）支持**300**、**3600**、 **86400**，如果不传该参数，默认值为**300**。

- 3-31天（不包含31天整）支持**3600**和**86400**，如果不传该参数，默认值为**3600**。

- 31天及以上支持**86400**，如果不传该参数，默认值为**86400**。
description.en:
The time granularity of the query. Unit: seconds. The valid values vary based on the time range specified by **StartTime** and **EndTime**:

- If the time range is less than 3 days (3 days excluded), valid values are **300**, **3600**, and **86400**. Default value: **300**.

- If the time range is from 3 to 31 days (31 days excluded), valid values are **3600** and **86400**. Default value: **3600**.

- If the time range is 31 days or longer, the valid value is **86400**. Default value: **86400**.

description.zh: 运营商英文名，通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)接口获得，默认查询所有运营商。
description.en: The English name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to query ISP names. By default, all ISPs are queried.

description.zh: 地域英文名，通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)接口获得，默认查询所有地域。
description.en: The English name of the region. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to query region names. By default, all regions are queried.

description.zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 是否自适应计算Interval值，如果**timeMerge**=**1**，会根据startTime和endTime计算出合适的inteval值，和Interval参数任选。
description.en: Specifies whether to adaptively calculate the Interval value. If **timeMerge** is set to **1**, an appropriate interval value is calculated based on StartTime and EndTime. You can specify this parameter or the Interval parameter.

title.zh: 获取平均响应时间数据
title.en: Queries the average response time of an accelerated domain name

descriptions.zh:
<props="china">阿里云CDN产品的统计分析功能已经下线，与统计分析功能相关的OpenAPI接口已不再继续维护。鉴于当前该接口可能存在数据缺失、不准确等问题，建议您不要使用该接口。如果您有数据统计分析相关的需求，可以通过[运营报表](~~279577~~)或者[投递实时日志到SLS](~~440145~~)来实现。</props>
<props="intl">阿里云CDN产品的统计分析功能已经下线，与统计分析功能相关的OpenAPI接口已不再继续维护。鉴于当前该接口可能存在数据缺失、不准确等问题，建议您不要使用该接口。如果您有数据统计分析相关的需求，可以通过[运营报表](~~279577~~)来实现。</props>
> - 如果您不指定StartTime和EndTime，该接口返回过去24小时的数据；指定StartTime和EndTime时，返回起止时间的数据。
> - 单用户调用频率：100次/秒。
> - 支持批量查询域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。
descriptions.en:
<props="china">The statistical analysis feature of Alibaba Cloud CDN has been discontinued, and the OpenAPI operations related to the statistical analysis feature are no longer maintained. Because data of this operation may be missing or inaccurate, we recommend that you do not use this operation. If you require data statistical analysis, you can use the [operations report](~~279577~~) feature or [deliver real-time logs to Simple Log Service (SLS)](~~440145~~).</props>
<props="intl">The statistical analysis feature of Alibaba Cloud CDN has been discontinued, and the OpenAPI operations related to the statistical analysis feature are no longer maintained. Because data of this operation may be missing or inaccurate, we recommend that you do not use this operation. If you require data statistical analysis, you can use the [operations report](~~279577~~) feature.</props>
> - If you do not specify StartTime or EndTime, data collected within the last 24 hours is queried. If you specify StartTime and EndTime, data collected within the specified time range is queried.
> - You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account.
> - You can specify multiple accelerated domain names and separate them with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names in each call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn describe-domain-average-response-time --time-merge 1 --domain-type domaintype --domain-name example.com --start-time 2019-11-30T05:33:00Z --end-time 2019-11-30T05:40:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainAverageResponseTime --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --DomainType domaintype --EndTime '2019-11-30T05:40:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --TimeMerge 1 --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2019-11-30T05:33:00Z' --Interval 300
